name: WdRelativeVerticalSize
description: Specifies the relative height of a shape using the value specified in the HeightRelative property for a Shape or ShapeRange object.

constants.name: wdRelativeVerticalSizeMargin
constants.description: Height is relative to the space between the left margin and the right margin.

constants.name: wdRelativeVerticalSizePage
constants.description: Height is relative to the height of the page.

constants.name: wdRelativeVerticalSizeTopMarginArea
constants.description: Height is relative to the size of the top margin.

constants.name: wdRelativeVerticalSizeBottomMarginArea
constants.description: Height is relative to the size of the bottom margin.

constants.name: wdRelativeVerticalSizeInnerMarginArea
constants.description: Height is relative to the size of the inside margin; to the size of the top margin for odd pages, and to the size of the bottom margin for even pages.

constants.name: wdRelativeVerticalSizeOuterMarginArea
constants.description: Height is relative to the size of the outside margin; to the size of the bottom margin for odd pages, and to the size of the top margin for even pages.
